mapper.select: SELECT SUM(psid.stock_in_qty) stockInQty FROM purchase_stock_in_detail psid LEFT JOIN purchase_stock_in psi ON psid.main_id = psi.id WHERE psi.approve_status = 'approve' AND psid.purchase_order_detail_id = #{purchaseOrderDetailId}

select psi.approve_status, psid.main_id, psid.sku_id, psid.sku_no, psid.variant_property, psid.purchase_qty, psid.receive_qty, psid.exceed_qty, psid.warehouse_location_id, psid.warehouse_location_name, psid.remark, psid.source_detail_id, psid.purchase_order_detail_id from purchase_stock_in psi inner join purchase_stock_in_detail psid on psi.id = psid.main_id and psid.is_deleted = false
psi.is_deleted and psi.invalid_status = false
and psid.source_detail_id in
#{item}
